Oval.description: The face length is greater than the width, with a gently rounded jawline.

Round.description: The face length and cheekbone width are roughly equal, with soft, curved angles.

Square.description: All measurements are fairly similar, featuring a sharp, strong jawline.

Oblong.description: The face length is the largest measurement, with the forehead, cheekbones, and jawline being similar in width.
Oblong.measurement_logic: (face_length > maximum(forehead_width, cheekbone_width, jawline_width)) AND (forehead_width ≈ cheekbone_width ≈ jawline_width)

Heart.description: The forehead is the widest part of the face, tapering down to a narrow, pointed chin.

Diamond.description: The cheekbones are the widest part of the face, with a narrower forehead and a pointed chin.
